etsy.title: Regex Poster, Now You Have Two Problems Programmer Joke, Coding Quote Wall Art, Gift for Developer
etsy.description:
A funny regex poster for the classic programmer joke: now you have two problems.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Regex on Etsy is mostly cheat-sheet posters and desk mats; the only joke print seen was a framed 'write once, read never' design.
A physical matte regex cheat sheet was listed at $24.99 and the framed joke print at $37; digital PDFs from about $2.
Programmer joke posters ('50 worst programmer jokes', 'not a bug, a feature') lead with the joke plus 'software developer wall art'.
No regex wall art surfaced on Amazon; regex appears only as a word in developer-skills T-shirts.
Amazon humor posters lead with 'Gifts for Software Developers' and name 'tech offices'.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. Etsy indexes 'regex' as a market phrase; 'regex poster' is its product-specific form. No priceRange: the two physical prices seen were a cheat sheet and a framed print, not comparable unframed joke posters.
